doc: The typical call with every input float64: no float32 rounding left, so the difference quotient is checked to rtol 1e-9 (the only difference is the summation order of the row means, relative 1e-16, amplified by the cancellation in lo - hi, at most 1e-13 here). Arguments: s, fine, thr, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads plus sensitivity_step. The floor 0.05 is a literal of the source. Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 2.2e-15 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is more than 1e5 times that spread.
